measurement_notes.smoothing_scheme: ERB-aligned log-Gaussian variable-octave (1/5 oct <=1.2 kHz -> 1/3 oct @ 2.6 kHz -> 1/2 oct >=4.8 kHz)
measurement_notes.regularization_scheme: Kirkeby-Nelson (1998) frequency-dependent Tikhonov beta(f) + C^inf softplus gain envelope
measurement_notes.phase_scheme: Oppenheim-Schafer 32768-pt real-cepstrum Hilbert minimum-phase + 256-sample raised-cosine tail taper
measurement_notes.normalization_scheme: Pink-weighted broadband passband unity (200 Hz - 12 kHz mean = 0.000 dB)

deep.name: Studio Deep
deep.description: Flagship Harman-warm in-room voicing (-0.85 dB/oct natural tilt + smooth +4.5 dB warmth shelf across 85-260 Hz), cleanly filling the 200-350 Hz cavern without woofer overload, eliminating the +4.2 dB @ 1.5 kHz glare, and restoring silky 6-14 kHz studio air.

spatial.name: Studio Spatial
spatial.description: Balanced cinema/XTC voicing (-0.55 dB/oct tilt + +3.0 dB warmth shelf 90-250 Hz), ultra-smooth midrange (300 Hz - 3 kHz) for pinpoint FDTR-XTC localization cues, and crisp 4-12 kHz pinna spatial detail.

reference.name: Studio Reference
reference.description: Harman/Olive mastering-neutral in-room target (-0.50 dB/oct natural room tilt + subtle +1.5 dB bass foundation 85-200 Hz), flat within +/-1.5 dB across 280 Hz - 10 kHz (pink-weighted RMS < 0.7 dB across 250 Hz - 10 kHz).

voice.name: Studio Voice
voice.description: Ultra-articulate speech/podcast voicing: clean 100 Hz sub-rumble rolloff, natural 160-280 Hz chest warmth (zero hollowness), subtle +1.5 dB consonant intelligibility lift (2.5-4.5 kHz), strict 6-8 kHz de-essing (zero sibilance), and gentle rolloff above 12 kHz.
